name: BattleHold
author: Machine
description: Battle Hold (combat warehouse): a separate combat cargo hold that shares the plane's total cargo capacity with the stock hold. Clearing the cargo hold never wipes combat cargo. The HUD panel sits bottom-right, can be dragged with the left mouse button and toggled with a rebindable hotkey (default 1) that shows up in Settings > Keybinds. Foundation mod for combat content - other mods depend on its API.
